capabilities: Show dimmed inline ghost-text and popup suggestions while typing
Rank completions from vault words, n-gram phrases, note titles, headings, and a bundled dictionary
Expand custom text snippets with {{date}}, {{time}}, {{title}}, and $CURSOR placement
Accept, cycle, or dismiss suggestions via keyboard shortcuts and mobile touch gestures
Yield to native menus inside wikilinks, links, and tags and suppress suggestions in frontmatter and code blocks
extras: Part of the author's DoomEsque offline suite (theme, Filetypes, Whole-Tree Search, and other plugins); every test run runs an offline-audit script that fails on any network API. It has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Beta installation via the BRAT plugin is documented.
motivation: The author built it as part of a suite guaranteeing zero network calls, so Obsidian can be used for notes during open-book law exams.
problem: Obsidian has no inline typing autocomplete; native suggestions only appear inside wikilinks, links, and tags, not for general words and phrases.
summary: Offline autocomplete plugin that shows inline ghost-text and popup suggestions from vault words, phrases, note titles, snippets, and a bundled dictionary.
